phase_name: API / Analytical Service (historical evidence access layer)

evidence_status.phase7_score: EMPIRICAL_POC_RISK_SCORE (not a deposit / ring / failure probability, not a plant limit)
evidence_status.phase8_o2_excluded_note: analyser-dependent (Kiln-I!X); not preferred; the analyser behaviour is an unresolved plant question

missing_months.reason: truncated workbook, unreadable; September is not scored
the April file repeats May data; April is absent

periods.timestamp_semantics: timezone-naive historian export (no timezone supplied; plant question open). Scores are 10-min buckets labelled by bucket end: a row at T covers (T - 10 min, T]. Timestamps are served exactly as stored, never converted, resampled or filled.

revalidation.source: Phase 8 P8Config.min_events_primary (run_manifest.json) and Phase 8 report section 25
revalidation.meaning: the minimum number of evaluable plant-labelled events before the frozen Phase 8 protocol can be re-run and classify anything; reaching it does not validate the score

disclaimers.risk_score: Retrospective empirical POC risk score: resemblance to abnormal process conditions relative to the Apr-May 2025 reference. It is not a prediction, an alert, or a deposit / ring / failure probability, and not an early warning.
disclaimers.o2_excluded: Sensitivity analysis only: the Phase 8 O2-excluded validation variant (Kiln-I!X removed). It does not replace the primary score and is not preferred.
disclaimers.abnormal_periods: KPI-derived empirical abnormal periods from the Phase 3 POC KPI. They are not plant events, incidents, deposits, rings or failures.
disclaimers.validation: Historical validation results only. Phase 8 did not support an early-warning claim against the KPI-derived abnormal periods. Nothing here is a live warning.
disclaimers.events: Plant event annotations are plant-supplied ground-truth candidates. They are never generated from the risk score or the KPI-derived periods.

limitations.detail: No coating, ring, deposit, cleaning, maintenance or stoppage-reason records exist in the supplied data. Detection, risk and early-warning claims cannot be validated against plant events.
Kiln-I September 2025 workbook is truncated and unreadable, so the score ends 2025-08-23 and September is not scored. Nothing is imputed.
The Kiln-IIIA April file repeats May data; April is absent for that dataset.
122 tags are frozen on 2025-05-06 11:50-21:50; masked in Phase 2 and treated as a data-quality window downstream.
Sentinel 99999 in 35 columns, -273 degC and text 'Error 6' are masked, not repaired.
13 columns are held pending plant unit confirmation and are excluded from the score.

Frequent ambient-air-like kiln-inlet O2 readings; excluding the analyser roughly halves the Jun-Aug score rise and changes the Phase 8 primary result from NOT_SUPPORTED to WEAK. The purge / calibration behaviour needs plant confirmation.
The score is higher at low feed and during load changes; the Phase 8 load-adjusted analysis is INSUFFICIENT_DATA.
RUNNING / STOPPED is a POC proxy from Kiln MD and feed; the meaning of Kiln MD and the equipment identity are unconfirmed.
Band levels and abnormal-period membership depend on the Apr-May reference; the plant has not confirmed a normal period.
6 of the 12 abnormal-period onsets are censored by the look-back cap; the small positive pre-onset estimate comes from them.
The historian export carries no timezone. The API serves naive timestamps unchanged and requires plant annotations to use the same naive plant-local clock.
The HIGH reference-relative band covers about half of August operational buckets; it is not a rare-event flag and not an alarm level.

plant_data_requirements.data: Timestamped coating / ring / deposit observations, cleaning, maintenance and stoppage logs (2025-04-01..2025-09-30)
Kiln-I!X O2 analyser purge / calibration schedule
Plant confirmation of a normal operating period
Operator / process-abnormality logs; event severity / impact

plant_data_requirements.unblocks: an outcome independent of the score inputs
independent evidence of coating / ring build-up (F15)

plant_data_requirements.data: Fuel laboratory data (CV, moisture, AFR split)
Kiln-I September 2025 re-export; meaning of Kiln MD; Sp.Heat F / G formulas; which tags are set-points

plant_questions_open: What is the purge / calibration behaviour of the Kiln-I!X O2 analyser?
Which period does the plant regard as normal?
What is the historian timezone and export interpolation setting?
Are the Kiln-I / IA / II / III / IIIA / IIIB folders pages of one kiln line?
prohibited_uses: reference-relative bands styled or used as alarm levels
lead-time or coverage figures presented as performance
never: prediction, forecast or probability of deposit / ring / failure
Phase 7 AUC 0.868 presented as accuracy (it is circular coverage)
